name: advanced-dsa-masterclass
title: Advanced DSA Masterclass: Pointers, Trees & Reversals
author: FeV-06
description: Comprehensive interactive course covering Doubly Linked Lists, BST hierarchical trees, and in-place three-pointer algorithms.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Doubly Linked List (Bidirectional Wiring)
lessons.description: Understand prev and next pointers, head/tail linking, and mutual unlinking.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Binary Search Tree Insertion
lessons.description: Visualize hierarchical heap nodes, left/right branches, and recursion.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: In-Place Three-Pointer Reversal
lessons.description: Watch prev, curr, and forward pointers rewire links in-place.
